_meta.status: UNVERIFIED PROTOTYPE DATA - red flags and self-care limits must be reviewed by a clinician before use.

severity_levels.emergency: Call the emergency number / go to an emergency department now.
severity_levels.urgent_doctor: Do not self-treat; see a doctor today.

general_red_flags.text: Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath at rest
Fainting, collapse, or very drowsy / hard to wake
Swelling of the face, lips or tongue, or a widespread rash with feeling very unwell
You feel extremely unwell or something feels seriously wrong

headache.label: Headache
headache.stop_advice: Stop self-treatment and see a doctor if the headache lasts more than 3 days, keeps coming back, gets worse, or you need painkillers on more than 2-3 days a week.

red_flags.text: Sudden, severe 'worst ever' headache that reached full strength within about a minute
Headache with fever AND a stiff neck, or a rash that does not fade when pressed
Headache after a head injury
Weakness, numbness, drooping face, slurred speech or difficulty walking
Confusion, change in behaviour, or a seizure (fit)
Loss of vision, double vision, or a painful red eye
You are pregnant or gave birth in the last 6 weeks
You are over 50 and this is a new or different type of headache
Headache that wakes you, gets worse lying down or coughing, or comes with repeated vomiting

fever.label: Fever
fever.stop_advice: See a doctor if the fever lasts more than 3 days, goes above 40 C, or you get new symptoms. In dengue season, get tested if fever persists.

red_flags.text: Temperature of 40 C (104 F) or higher
Stiff neck, or a rash that does not fade when pressed
Bleeding gums or nose, blood in vomit or stool, unusual bruising, severe tummy pain or repeated vomiting
Confusion or a seizure (fit)
Cannot keep fluids down, or passing very little urine
You are on chemotherapy, long-term steroid tablets, or have a weakened immune system

musculoskeletal_pain.label: Mild muscle / joint / back pain
musculoskeletal_pain.stop_advice: See a doctor if the pain lasts more than 5 days, gets worse, or stops you from normal activities.

red_flags.text: After a fall or injury, with deformity, or you cannot bear weight or move the limb
A hot, red, swollen joint, especially with fever
Back pain with leg weakness or numbness, numbness around the genitals or buttocks, or new bladder/bowel problems
Pain in the chest, left arm, jaw or upper back with sweating or breathlessness
Pain in one calf with swelling, warmth or redness

common_cold.label: Common cold symptoms (aches, sore throat, mild fever)
common_cold.stop_advice: See a doctor if symptoms last more than 7 days, get worse after improving, or you develop high fever, ear or face pain.

red_flags.text: Fever above 39 C lasting more than 3 days
Coughing up blood
Wheezing or noisy breathing
Symptoms improved and then suddenly got much worse

allergic_rhinitis.label: Hay fever / allergic runny nose
allergic_rhinitis.stop_advice: See a doctor or pharmacist if there is no improvement after 14 days, or symptoms affect your sleep or breathing.

red_flags.text: Wheezing, or your asthma is getting worse
Eye pain or changes in vision
Blocked on one side only, with blood or a foul-smelling discharge

heartburn.label: Heartburn / indigestion
heartburn.stop_advice: See a doctor if you need an antacid for more than 14 days, or symptoms keep returning.

red_flags.text: Difficulty or pain when swallowing
Vomiting blood or 'coffee grounds', or black tarry stools
Weight loss you cannot explain
Chest pain spreading to the arm, jaw or neck, or with sweating or breathlessness
You are over 55 and this is new heartburn
Repeated vomiting

diarrhoea.label: Mild diarrhoea
diarrhoea.stop_advice: Keep drinking fluids / ORS. See a doctor if diarrhoea lasts more than 48 hours, or blood, fever or severe pain appears.

red_flags.text: Blood or mucus in the stool, or black stools
Fever of 38 C or higher
Severe tummy pain or a swollen tummy
Signs of dehydration: very little or dark urine, dizziness on standing, very dry mouth
Started after taking antibiotics or a hospital stay
